name: particle-academy/fine-print
description: First-party PDF reader for agentic docs, in pure PHP with zero runtime dependencies. Parses PDFs (xref tables and streams, incremental updates, object streams, Flate/LZW/ASCII85/ASCIIHex/RunLength), extracts text in reading order, reports active content (JavaScript, launch actions, forms, embedded files) without ever executing it, and passes everything an agent reads through a prompt-injection guard that can flag, redact or discard. Hostile-input limits refuse bombs, cycles and corrupt files cleanly.
